acceptance criteria, deferrals clause). Load list honoured: canonical spec

§5.2 (stage table + approval record), §6.2 (`sig.latest-pointer/2`,

§6.4 (V-suites incl. V1–V3 flip checks, V7 api-parity), §7/GT-9
(SIG_STAGING gate), §9.2/§11/§15 (NEW-7, NEW-10); the landed P35.53
machinery (`release_pipeline.py` — registry store, LOCK, event journal,
state digest, dry-run/apply, deferred-verb skeleton; `release_serving.py`
— the withdrawal barrier + tombstone/entity-stub emitters;
`release_publish_verify.py` — the V7 `api_parity_check` reused, never
re-implemented; `job_roll.py` — the digest-pinned roll convention);
`exports/release.py` (`build_release` artifact set — `releases/<pub>/`
carries `catalog_entry.json` + `release.json` + `integrity_manifest.json`);
`exports/release_identity.py` (`labels.json` shape); `ops/web/nginx.conf`
(the legacy config this row templates); `ops/docker-compose.yml` (the
serving profile + `web` service); `tests/e2e/test_serving_topology.py`
(the composed proof surface conventions). G3 line 170 noted: labels.conf
is generated "from the catalog" (label → pub aliases, append-only).

Key facts recorded before implementation:

- `promoted.map` is a generation file inside the `map $uri_pub $promoted`
  block — `default 0` makes unpromoted namespaces 404 by construction
  (AC-1: "refuses by construction").
- `withdrawn.conf`/`selectors.conf`/`labels.conf` are carried whole into
  `conf/<gen+1>` — the contract says "consumed here, written there" (P35.55
  owns the writer). `labels.conf` is additionally re-composed whole from
  the label→pub alias set so a newly promoted label resolves (G3 line 170).
- The narrow residual — a disposition recorded between a candidate's V10
  run and its promote does not appear in the carried map for routes only
  the new pub serves — is filed as `D-P35.54-1` (owner: the P35.55 writer
  / V-suite), never smoothed.
- `sig-ops release verify` already runs `api_parity_check` (V7, §6.4) at
  candidate stage; promote re-invokes the same check against the staged
  tree — invoked, never re-implemented.
- `nginx:alpine` runs `/docker-entrypoint.d/*.sh` before nginx starts and
  ships `envsubst`; the entrypoint renders only when `SIG_CONF_GEN` and
  `SIG_LATEST_PUB` are both set, refuses a half-set env, and falls back to
  the committed legacy config when neither is set (the dark cutover roll
  is row 336's leg — until then a roll without the release env keeps
  today's behaviour verbatim).
- `X-SIG-Release` + `X-SIG-Conf-Gen` are rendered per revision
  (`add_header ... always` — §6.3 says every response including errors).
- `SIG_LATEST_LABEL` joins the env set: `X-SIG-Release` carries
  `"<label> <pub>"` per §4.2/§6.3 (the label is not derivable from pub).
- nginx `add_header` inheritance: a `location` declaring any `add_header`
  inherits none from `server` — the provenance pair (+ the staging
  noindex line) is emitted via a rendered `sig-headers.conf` include
  repeated per location.
- Approval record: `registry/approvals/<name>.json` objects of schema
  `sig.promotion-approval/1` (agent-drafted minimal shape — `kind` ∈
  {standing_go, signed_readout}; class S requires a signed_readout naming
  the pub; expiry/revocation honoured). The verb checks the record the
  operator writes; it never creates one.
- Roll order: `sig-api` then `sig-web` (§5.1/§4.3) — an api revision that
  can't serve the release is never publicly reachable because web's flip
  is gated on api's roll succeeding. `min-instances=1` on the web leg
  keeps the latest view up through the flip.
- Staging guard: the roll planner refuses `SIG_STAGING=1` env on any
  service not named `*-staging`, and refuses any non-digest image ref
  (`sha256:<64>` pin, job_roll's `DIGEST_REF` shape).
- `catalog.json` v2 (`sig.publication-catalog/2`) entries derive from the
  journal fold + `staged/releases/<pub>/catalog_entry.json`; `state`
  per pub: `promoted` (current latest) / `superseded` (promoted earlier)
  / the journal's last lifecycle state / `never-promoted` (label-only).
- `releases/` index + `releases/catalog.json` + `releases/latest.json` are
  generated into the generation by the release tool alone (C4 NEW-10);
  `latest.json` is served twice (conf dir + releases alias) byte-identical.
- `/entity/` needs no dedicated location: the v/ tree carries the stub
  pages; the withdrawn.conf deny lines cover the stub aliases via the
  internal `/conf/tombstone/` location (P34.41's URI shape preserved).
- `release_*.conf` glob is retired in the release template: the
  `X-SIG-Release` header is env-rendered per §4.2 now (a stale fragment
  would double-emit). `chrome_*`/`terms_*`/`renamed_*` globs carry over
  under `/mnt/rel/staged/conf/` (D-P34.13-1's surface, generated by
  `sig-ops web-conf`).
- Entity stubs (deliverable 5): the stub coverage the alias rules serve is
  proven by (a) the v/ tree serving the emitted stubs under `location /`
  and (b) a carried withdrawn.conf stub deny answering 410 through the
  internal tombstone location — both exercised in the composed proof.

## Implementation

Landed:

- `ops/web/nginx.conf` → the G3 §4.2 envsubst template (promoted-map
  gate, per-generation includes, staged conf globs, release-index
  locations rooted at `conf/${SIG_CONF_GEN}`, the `/r/`·`/s/`·
  `/releases/<pub>/` gated namespaces, the P35.52 hashed-PMTiles
  location and `/entity/` preserved verbatim); `ops/web/sig-headers.conf`
  the per-location provenance include; `ops/web/sig-conf-entrypoint.sh`
  the render script (half-set env refuses, absent env → legacy);
  `ops/web/nginx-legacy.conf` the frozen fallback; `ops/web/Dockerfile`
  ships all of it and validates both postures at build.
- `ops/src/ops/release_conf.py` (~1,265 lines) — the conf-generation
  composer + promote engine: journal fold, candidate checks (staged →
  verified → classified, approval, not-already-promoted), immutable
  `conf/<gen+1>` writes (resumable in place), `releases/` index set,
  api→web digest-pinned roll planning with injected runner, `promoted`
  event.
- `release_pipeline.py` `verb_promote` + `cli.py` promote parser —
  dry-run default, `--apply`, lock/break-lock/stale-generation semantics.
- `ops/docker-compose.yml` — `release-serving` profile: `web` gains the
  release env + `/mnt/rel:ro` mount; `web-staging` (`SIG_STAGING=1`).
- `tests/ops/test_release_conf.py` (36 tests), `tests/e2e/
  test_release_generations.py` (3 composed proofs),
  `test_serving_topology_ops.py` updated for the template + profile shape.
- `docs/adr/ADR-220-…`, `CHANGELOG` entry, `D-P35.54-1`.

Debug arc worth keeping: nginx `map` regexes must be unquoted —
`~"…"` parses but never matches, and `{64}` is a block opener in a map
block either way (loose `+` quantifier; the `default 0` gate makes
shape-strictness unnecessary); `~"…"` named-capture debugging also
confirmed positional `$1` fails the same way. `map_hash_bucket_size 128`
for the 66-byte pub keys. `alias`+`index` 500s on the dir request —
`/releases/` surfaces `root` into the conf dir instead. The stock
`20-envsubst-on-templates.sh` was kept from double-rendering by keeping
templates out of `/etc/nginx/templates/`.

Verification (recorded at head):

- `tests/ops/test_release_conf.py` — 36 passed.
- `tests/ops/test_serving_topology_ops.py` — 12 passed.
- `tests/e2e/test_release_generations.py` — 3 passed (composed, real
  Docker: promoted `/r/<pub>/` 200 + provenance headers, unpromoted 404,
  `/releases/`+`latest.json`+`catalog.json` out of `conf/<gen>`, label
  alias 301, staging origin ungated + noindex).
- Manual composed probe: `/` 200, `/r/<pub>/` 200, `/releases/` 200,
  `/r/<other>/` 404, `/releases/<label>/` → 301.
